headline: Ukraine changes rules for power cut-offs over debts
summary: The National Commission for State Regulation of Energy and Public Utilities amended the Rules of the Retail Electricity Market. The changes strengthen consumer protection during disconnection and restoration of power supply over debts.
why: The energy regulator sets rules for electricity retail markets, affecting utility collections, payment practices and consumer protections.
